{{Quote|That's the last of them, Bokar. These two are dead. Still no sign of Fell.''"<br />"''He may have escaped, but his daughter was captured, and will soon be on her way to Coruscant.|Yuln and Bokar|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
'''Bokar''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], Bokar and the [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Yuln]] were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to search for surviving enemies following a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] between Sith forces and an allied group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Imperial Knight]]s. Three [[Time/Legends|days]] after the Sith attacked Agamar, Bokar and Yuln were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]] and Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]], respectively.

==Biography==
{{Quote|And many Jedi and Imperial Knights died, Yuln, proving they are ''weaker'' than we Sith."''<br />"''Sith perished as well, Bokar."''<br />"''Weaklings! Better they be culled from the ranks of the One Sith!|Bokar and Yuln|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
[[File:Rasi_Tuum_kills_Bokar.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Bokar is slain by Rasi Tuum on Agamar.]]
Bokar, a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], served in the [[One Sith|Sith Order]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 48" /> In [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Extremes" /> [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith–Imperial]] forces attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], intending to [[Operation: Thunderstroke|capture or kill]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. Bokar and fellow Sith [[Yuln]] were dispatched to the surface of Agamar after the battle to search for Fel and [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] any of his surviving [[Imperial Knight]]s and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />

Three [[Time/Legends|days]] after the attack on Agamar, as they were searching for survivors of the battle, Yuln informed Bokar that all the remaining Jedi and Imperial Knights were deceased. The two Sith began arguing about the strength of the Sith, Jedi, and Imperial Knights who had fallen during the battle, but they were interrupted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]], who slew Bokar. Yuln was killed by a surprise attack from the Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Bokar-Yuln-Confronted-Legacy48.png|thumb|right|300px|Bokar (center) had red and black tattoos.]]
Bokar believed that every Jedi and Imperial Knight casualty on Agamar proved that the Sith were superior to both organizations and that the Sith who perished in the fighting were "weaklings" who deserved to be discarded from the One Sith's ranks. The humanoid had long [[Color|black]] [[hair]] and red-rimmed yellow [[Eye/Legends|irises]],<ref name="Legacy 48" /> the latter of which was a trait of users of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Equipment==
Bokar's body was covered in [[Color/Legends|red]] and black [[Sith tattoo]]s, with a [[Piercing/Legends|piercing]] in the left [[Ear/Legends|ear]]. The Sith wore black [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with a black [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] and robes and also owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bokar was introduced by [[John Ostrander]], author of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, in the [[Legacy (2006) 48|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes|''Extremes'']] story arc. The issue was penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]<ref name="Legacy 48" /> and released on [[May 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54420/star_wars_legacy_2006_48|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #48}}</ref>
